tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: The account's plan and credits left. Free.

tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: The kinds, styles, story shapes, formats and writers this account can make, with the ids quote_short takes. Free; a card shows them.

tools.name: quote_short
tools.description: Prices a new short as a quote_id; nothing is charged until make_short runs with it.

tools.name: make_short
tools.description: Makes the short a quote_short quote priced and charges exactly that, or holds a range's top and charges what it took; one quote_id never charges twice. Making time varies by format; get_short reports progress.

tools.name: get_short
tools.description: Status, step, length, format and script; app_url and edit_url (its timeline) open it for the signed-in person only; once exported, an MP4 link (one hour) and post copy. Free; waits up to 50 s.

tools.name: list_shorts
tools.description: The account's recent shorts, newest first, with status. Free.

tools.name: quote_edit
tools.description: Plans a change asked in plain words and prices it as a quote_id, and the ask and reply join the short's chat; nothing changes or is charged until edit_short runs with it.

tools.name: edit_short
tools.description: Applies a quote_edit plan and charges exactly that; no quote_id charges twice. A quote on a short that changed since is refused.

tools.name: set_caption_words
tools.description: Sets words per caption (1 to 6, null resets), free; export again after. Rendered shorts need layered captions.

tools.name: get_short_view
tools.description: A short's timeline as its editor shows it: tracks with rows by id and time, captions and the free edits open now. Free; read it before propose_edits.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: What each free edit does and the fields it takes, then those closed on this short and why. Free.

tools.name: propose_edits
tools.description: Dry-runs free edits as the editor would and returns what would change and a session_id; nothing is saved or charged. Show the person, then apply_edit_session or discard_edit_session.

tools.name: apply_edit_session
tools.description: Saves a proposed session as one free change the person can undo in one step, once. Returns the new revision and the rows it changed.

tools.name: discard_edit_session
tools.description: Drops a proposed session; the short stays as it is. Free.

tools.name: undo_edit
tools.description: Steps free edits back (undo) or forward (redo), or restores a cut's earlier version by number. Free; refused if the short changed since revision.

tools.name: quote_export
tools.description: Prices an MP4 export of a short or first cut as a quote_id; nothing is charged until export_short runs with it.

tools.name: export_short
tools.description: Exports the MP4 a quote_export quote priced and charges exactly that; the same quote_id never charges twice. get_short has the link once it is done.

tools.name: check_export
tools.description: Stills at the times asked and the loudness of the short's exported MP4, to look it over. Free; after a change, export again first.

tools.name: list_kits
tools.description: The person's private brand kits (their 2D animation look) and presets. Free.

tools.name: save_kit
tools.description: Changes the kit_id kit (make_default picks it), else saves a new one from a preset, a copy or surprise. Free.
